entries.title: Lobby loading hotfix
changes: Fixed the lobby getting stuck on "Loading games..." forever on a network hiccup, with a Retry button on failure

entries.title: Dark mode hotfix
changes: Fixed dark mode auto-activating (and making the page look broken) for anyone whose device defaults to dark mode

entries.title: Gaia 18 UI improvements
changes: Rebranded to "GP: Fight Club"
Info buttons now open a popup instead of expanding inline text
Active tab no longer double-lists your own games
Choose-Bid and Bid-While-Choosing auction variants selectable at game creation
Nickname editor auto-opens for accounts still on a default nickname
Ban Phase / Sector 1-4 tags shown on game rows
Direct-invite game creation with a nickname-sorted player picker
Pulsing online-player-count indicator on mobile
Fixed avatar and score-badge overlap in the game bar
In-game settings menu: abandon game and dark/light mode toggle
Faction pick/ban popup shows the real round-1 starting position
Fixed deleted admin users leaving a ghost account behind

entries.title: Gaia 17: setup features
changes: Optional ban phase for faction selection, usable with any pick/auction variant
Optional official center-sector (1-4) map rule
Redesigned faction-info popup with real in-game icons and a faction board preview
Used special-action indicator now shows on claimed tech tiles too

entries.title: Fix invisible your-turn pulse
changes: The green "your turn" pulse on the lobby game bar was being rendered correctly but clipped to invisible by its own swipe-to-delete container - now shows as an inset glow instead.

entries.title: Fix missing move-age on some games
changes: Time since last move no longer silently disappears for some games - it was relying on a query that could hit a row limit once the project had enough total moves across all games.

entries.title: Lobby game-bar polish
changes: Open-lobby games now show a green X/Y seats-joined badge where the round number goes, instead of an empty slot.
Move age no longer disappears if the client clock is even slightly behind the server's.

entries.title: Gaia 16 bug-fix batch
changes: Building on a Protoplanet via a Federation token's or Standard Tech tile's free mine now correctly grants +6 VP.
Statistics panel VP totals now match the player board (a Lost Fleet Federation-tile rescore's VP was being silently dropped from the total).
Lobby game previews now show the map.
Off-turn sticky bar now matches the on-turn bar's look and no longer floats while scrolling.
Push notifications now open the specific game instead of the lobby.
Online status now shows recently-active players even while their tab is minimized.
Game tabs now sort by your-turn-first, then most-recently-active.
Faction board gained Protoplanet/Asteroid planet counters alongside the Gaia counter.
Game-bar turn summaries no longer get overwritten by leech/income decision moves.

entries.title: Private access control
changes: New accounts start unapproved and see no game data until approved from Settings > Manage users

entries.title: Hosted persistence repair
changes: Hosted games now repair stale move-count drift before the first turn save, preventing setup picks from snapping back to player 1.
A new hot-seat Playwright harness covers faction-pick and setup-move persistence through a full reload.

entries.title: Hosted faction-pick persistence
changes: Hosted games now retry seat claiming before giving up on a faction pick or turn save.
Games that briefly lose seat ownership during setup no longer snap back to player 1's faction picker after resync.

entries.title: Hosted sync and lobby fixes
changes: Hosted turns now resync correctly when another tab or player already committed a conflicting move.
The lobby now opens on public tables first, and open-table visibility is backed by the latest SQL policy update.
The duplicate top turn banner is gone, and full setup previews use the main game layout so maps load more reliably.

entries.title: More reliable full setup previews
changes: Open lobby setup previews now carry their own map and board SVG definitions so missing art is less likely on mobile.
The full setup preview now uses the same sizing rules as the main game screen, which helps the map render correctly.

entries.title: Steadier lobby setup previews
changes: Open lobby tables no longer reload the full setup preview just because seats change.
Lobby setup previews now load their board art and map more reliably on first open.

entries.title: Cleaner lobby previews
changes: Open lobby tables now show one join action with joined player names instead of a full seat-by-seat button list.
Setup previews now load the map and board art more reliably on the full-page lobby screen.

entries.title: Full-page lobby previews
changes: Open lobby tables now open on their own page with compact seat controls above the setup preview.

entries.title: Faster setup-turn updates
changes: Initial faction and mine placement now update immediately after you confirm instead of appearing to stall on the same prompt.

entries.title: Open lobby tables and compact release notes
changes: New games now open in the lobby for players to join instead of requiring direct invites.
Open tables show the setup preview, faction-pick mode, occupied seats, and join or leave actions until the game auto-starts.
The changelog now keeps only short player-facing highlights instead of every developer follow-up fix.

entries.title: Hosted lobby and mobile polish
changes: The hosted lobby uses the compact list layout with Active and Finished tabs.
Mobile play shows cleaner top-bar turn state, premove controls, and refreshed faction/setup presentation.

entries.title: Smarter turn notifications
changes: Desktop devices still get turn alerts even while the game is open.
Mobile and installed PWA sessions keep duplicate-alert suppression while you are actively playing.

entries.title: Correct fourth exploration reward
changes: The fourth spaceship exploration slot in 4-player Lost Fleet games now charges exactly 3 power.

entries.title: In-app update prompt
changes: Hosted tabs can detect when a newer version was deployed and prompt you to reload into it.
